scene: Steam curls across tiled floors inside the bathhouse lobby, warm and quiet.
picture: Side-scrolling view of a bathhouse lobby on flat blue tile. Far left, shut wooden shoe lockers. Left, a tall wooden reception counter holding an untouched brass bell. Centre, the grandfather in navy apron stands holding his bicycle with plant crate. Right, a bubbling indoor footbath tub. Far right, an open arched hallway hung with red lanterns.
shown: a shining brass bell sits silent on the tall counter at the left
a row of numbered wooden shoe lockers stands shut at the far left
an arched hallway strung with red lanterns stands open on the far right
